reviews.text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
I couldn’t be happier with my dog’s grooming experience! The groomer is so caring, gentle, and patient, and it’s clear how much love they have for the dogs they care for. My little fur baby always looks absolutely adorable after a visit! 🐶❤️
Great experience! Plinio is very friendly and professional, and my dog always comes home happy. Highly recommend!

Amazing dog grooming time after time. Awesome job. The difference?  They detected a tic on my dog today. Got to the vet to have it removed.  Very good thing according to the vet and it was removed right away. That’s beyond anything I could expect.  Real pros and real animal lovers. Thanks Plinio and the team at Grooming Show!!!!
Amazing experience , amazing service . Super with the pups & beautifully groomed ! Highly recommend

I was looking into a great new groomer for my yorkie. I can say this was the first time but not the last. Im always scared to try a new groomer because of bad experiences but Plinio was great and very nice. I could see he cared about my little boy. The result of the grooming was better than expected, a clean and nice cut. Chip looks handsome! Thank you so much!
Excellent work, high-quality grooming and impeccable service!
Really friendly and welcoming, the place is spotless and respectful, my dog ​​got a great haircut and he looks amazing
I love this place! They take care of my two frenchies! Highly recommend!
Very nice people at this place.

Absolutely perfect grooming! Meticulous, careful work, done with so much love. My dog ​​came out looking magnificent, squeaky clean, and so handsome! Bravo for this exceptional work; you can really see the attention to detail. ❤️🐾

Luna is a purebred Shiba Inu, and honestly, this is one of the best groomers I’ve ever had the pleasure of bringing her to! 🐕🤍

They always wash and blow-dry her so thoroughly, trim her nails perfectly, and do such an amazing job brushing and de-shedding her coat. You can really tell they care about the dogs and pay attention to every little detail.

Luna always comes home looking and smelling amazing, with her coat so clean, soft, and fluffy! 🥰 They are also so gentle and patient with her, which means so much to me.

Highly recommend them, especially for Shiba Inu owners! 🐾✨
I am so impressed by their new look. They never looked this good 👍 …
Lovely staff, took great care of our dog!

they nipped my dog's private parts and didnt mention it. Despite this, charged me full price and asked me to leave a positive review for them.
Bad experience and bad business, complete lack of transparency and honesty. i will not be visiting ever again.
